import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

pattern = re.compile(
    r"^[ \t]*(a|b|c|d|TMP)[ \t]*<-[ \t]*(a|b|c|d|TMP|-?\d+)[ \t]*;",
    re.MULTILINE,
)

for match in pattern.finditer(text):
    target, source = match.groups()
    values[target] = values[source] if source in values else int(source)

print(
    f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; "
    f"c ?= {values['c']}; d ?= {values['d']}; "
    f"TMP ?= {values['TMP']};"
)
